metadata.name: Drop2Shoot
metadata.description:
[h1]You can now play the game using only your left hand[/h1] When holding the DROP key, Isaac will shoot in the direction of his gaze! While moving and holding the DROP key, Isaac will no longer drop trinkets! Play the game with your left hand, and your right hand is free to snack on some food!
The mod is OFF by default. left-click on the 'Drop2Shoot' text at the bottom of the screen to toggle the mod ON/OFF; right-click and drag to move the text display position. [hr][/hr] [h1]你将可以只用左手玩游戏[/h1] 按住丢弃键时，以撒会向目光方向射击！ 移动时按住丢弃键，以撒将不会再丢掉饰品！ 用左手玩游戏，右手可以吃零食啦！
模组默认处于关闭状态，左键单击屏幕下方的'Drop2Shoot'开启/关闭功能状态；右键可拖动文字显示位置。
